reports.moments: The 23rd Ranger Squad of the I Arnorian Legion honed their aim, releasing a devastating volley that halted the Wargs advance, it was without a doubt what lead the I Arnorian to such a stunning Victory.
reports.story:
The Southern Wastes, ordinarily desolate and quiet, found itself embroiled in a fierce Skirmish as the I Arnorian Legion led by King Arvedui arrived to cut off the reinforcements being sent to silence the I Rivendell Legion who were actively conquering The Etten Moors. 

The Ensuing Battle was quick but bloody, the men of Arnor accepted that maintaining control of the battlefield was simply not possible, the only way they'd possibly win this battle is by making the battle not worth fighting to the last. So they adopred a defensive position, drawing the Wargins into an open field of fire. This plan worked perfectly, the Wargs rushed in on Arvedui's flank and were devestated by a hail of Ranger Arrows killing many before the lines even met, then with Arvedui at the helm the forces of Arnor surged fourth to counter charge the approaching Wargs. 

The ensuing brawl favoring Arnor as their numbers and brave King proved too much for the Wargs.Malbeth's Center force however did not enjoy as much success, his forces were quickly  destroyed by Wolf Packs Center, overwhelmed by their numbers and Strength, But luckily they were forced to retreat to avoid total annihilation and to attempt to preserve their remaining numbers. Victory was grapsed by the brave men of Arnor, the first of many battles in the Campaign For Eriador.
reports.title: The Battle of Southern Waste

reports.author: Evil
reports.story:
While scouting out northern territories, the Gondor Frontiersman were fallen upon by Aldrac, Warlord of Carn Dum along with 2 packs of wargs.

	Orc warg riders managed to bog down the left flank as Aldrac and his men charged the right and middle. Boromir led the defense of the main forces. The defending Gondorians formed a shieldwall, yet Aldrac and his fell sorcerer Fraecht managed to break it before the wargs arrived with the help of their Troll. Fighting ensued that remained even at first yet soon the ferocity of the Carn Dum overwhelmed the Gondorians. As the wargs arrived the Gondorians saw no hope as Aldrac had slew their general so they retreated with the wolves and men of Angmar on their tail.
reports.title: The Battle of North Downs
